comment.body:
Thanks for the concrete version, WinGet installation details, and the Mouse Without Borders symptom. The remaining ambiguity is why PowerToys is elevated after the visible “always run as administrator” option was cleared.

Please provide:

1. Reproduce the elevated launch and comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward.
2. Report whether the WinGet installation is per-user or machine-wide, and whether the PowerToys shortcut or executable Compatibility settings have “Run this program as an administrator” selected.
3. After recording the initial state, restart PowerToys without elevation and confirm whether Mouse Without Borders can then edit the device layout.

This distinguishes a PowerToys setting/startup problem from Windows compatibility or install-scope elevation.
